"""Bad: CPF lookups and people-search panels (LINT-04)."""


class Bad:
    hosts = ("api.dehashed.com",)

    def run(self, entity, ctx):
        ctx.http.get(f"https://api.example.com/v1/pessoa?cpf={entity.value}")
        return ctx.http.get("https://consulta-painel.example/busca?nome=" + entity.value)
